verses.text: Ach in Diosal, kolin icha ajnak halan t'ayin. Kolin yujto syal u'uj smasanil.
Ach in Diosal, ab' in lesal tik. Ak'kot tz'eyan a chikin t'a tas swala'.
Yujto a heb' anima manh wojtakok tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' komonnhej tz'ak'an chukal t'a yetanima'il. Snib'ej heb' to tzin chami. Malaj elk'och t'a heb'.
Palta jun, tik wal a ach ayachoch wet'ok. Tik wal u'uj pitzan in.
Ha schukal heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayin ol meltzajoch t'a yib'anh u'uj. Mamin, satkanel heb' yujto tzak'nhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, ol wak' in silab' t'ayach t'a yol wiko', ol ach in b'itani yujto wach' ach,
yujto ix in a kolel t'a smasanil wilk'olal. Ix wilan skan heb' ajk'o'ol t'ayin t'a yalanh u'uj.
